label: advisor
definition: The role that reads the board and the terms and tells the owner which work to start, which word a thing has, and which skill serves it. Named here so the skills that will fill it have a term; the skill does not exist yet.
is_not: The captain: the captain executes an approved plan; the advisor helps the owner decide one.
A builder: the advisor writes no code.
kit-plan-next: that skill proposes what to build; the advisor also answers what a word means and which skill to call.
